configuration.change: Uniformly scale the accepted l25 optical depth with one global multiplier; keep the same finite dust structure and Gordon law.

details.geometry: Every centre, axis, weight, relative column contrast, depth and sky position is inherited exactly.
details.calibration: Only the optical-depth conversion is scaled. Raw source columns and inferred regional ordering are retained, not claimed to be remeasured.
details.unchanged: All stellar light, source amplitudes, population colors, component RGB grades and display curve.
details.excluded: No unresolved-clump response, spatial smoothing, lane-dependent opacity, foreground movement or photographic transfer.

execution: Each renderer and field-loader process uses node --max-old-space-size=8192. This applies only to the source reference experiment, not the package build.
